dict.string: Sunzzari uses your camera to capture photos of wines, restaurants, and moments to share.
Sunzzari needs access to your photo library so you can post stories and add memories.
Sunzzari can save photos from the shared album to your camera roll.
Sunzzari reads your period dates from Apple Health and adds them to your shared Cycle calendar.
Sunzzari only reads your period dates. It never saves anything to Apple Health.
Sunzzari shows your location on the shared map so you can see where each other is.
Sunzzari updates your location in the background so your partner always knows where you are.
